The text is a fragment beginning mid-list (Kinesiology) and cut off in the Physics section.
The UC list notes 'No credit for MUS V01 if taken after MUS V02A' — a UC transfer credit limit, not a degree rule.
A reviewer should obtain the actual Music A.A.-T program page for the 2026-2027 catalog to record requirements.
